raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "2023.2.0" %}
{% set tcm_version = "1.6.0" %}

{% set vtag = "v" ~ version.replace(".rc", "-rc") %}

# Libraries on Windows are expected to be installed into LIBRARY_PREFIX.
# tbb4py files should be installed into PREFIX.
# See https://docs.conda.io/projects/conda-build/en/latest/user-guide/environment-variables.html.
# On non-Windows CMAKE_ARGS already contains CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX.
# CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH is needed to discover libhwloc with PkgConfig.
# TCM is built as a separate output (tcm), so it is disabled for the TBB outputs.
{% if win %}
    {% set cmake_args = "%CMAKE_ARGS% -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=%LIBRARY_PREFIX% -DTBB_DISABLE_HWLOC_AUTOMATIC_SEARCH=OFF -DTCM_BUILD=OFF" %}
    {% set cmake_tcm_args = "%CMAKE_ARGS% -DTCM_GENERATE_VARS=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=%LIBRARY_PREFIX%" %}
    {% set cmake_tbb4py_args = "%CMAKE_ARGS% -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=%PREFIX% -DTBB_DISABLE_HWLOC_AUTOMATIC_SEARCH=OFF -DTCM_BUILD=OFF" %}
{% else %}
    {% set cmake_args = "$CMAKE_ARGS -DTBB_DISABLE_HWLOC_AUTOMATIC_SEARCH=OFF -DTCM_BUILD=OFF" %}
    {% set cmake_tcm_args = "$CMAKE_ARGS -DTCM_GENERATE_VARS=OFF" %}
    {% set cmake_tbb4py_args = "$CMAKE_ARGS -DTBB_DISABLE_HWLOC_AUTOMATIC_SEARCH=OFF -DTCM_BUILD=OFF" %}
{% endif %}

# Use specific test list agreed with TBB team to cover core functionality on high level.
# Execution of all tests is too heavy task for packaging CI.
# test_malloc_compliance is temporary excluded from the list since it causes failures that likely appear due to test implementation or env misconfiguration.
# oneTBB issue: https://github.com/uxlfoundation/oneTBB/issues/700
# Agreed with oneTBB developers that it is suitable approach since the product is fully tested on oneTBB side.
{% set tests = "test_parallel_for test_tbb_header conformance_version test_flow_graph test_arena_constraints" %}
{% set ctest_regex = "^(%s)$" % (tests.replace(' ', '|')) %}

{% set tbb4py_build_dir = "build_$PKG_HASH" %}  # [not win]
{% set tbb4py_build_dir = "build_%PKG_HASH%" %}  # [win]

package:
  name: onetbb
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/uxlfoundation/oneTBB/archive/refs/tags/{{ vtag }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 80cb62e62defeee67ea1885a6f72d97ac81404f8fde9cded62fb51524808a30c
  patches:
    - patches/0001-disable-windows-path-hack-that-s-wrong-for-conda.patch
    - patches/0002-tcm-install-rules.patch
    - patches/0003-tbb-process-shutdown.patch
    - patches/0004-tcm-fix-test-rb.patch

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - name: tcm
    version: {{ tcm_version }}
    about:
      summary: Thread Composability Manager (TCM)
      license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
      license_file:
        - thread_composability_manager/licensing/LICENSE.txt
        - thread_composability_manager/licensing/third-party-programs.txt
    build:
      skip: true  # [osx]
      script:
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja      # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=   # [win].
        - cmake {{ cmake_tcm_args }} -DTCM_TEST=OFF -S thread_composability_manager -B build_tcm
        - cmake --build build_tcm --parallel
        - cmake --install build_tcm --component runtime
      ignore_run_exports:
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - winpthreads          # [win]
        - libwinpthread        # [win]
        - libxml2              # [not win]
        - libxml2-16           # [not win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ninja                # [win]
        - make                 # [not win]
        - cmake
      host:
        - libhwloc
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]

  - name: tcm-devel
    version: {{ tcm_version }}
    about:
      summary: Thread Composability Manager (TCM)
      license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
      license_file:
        - thread_composability_manager/licensing/LICENSE.txt
        - thread_composability_manager/licensing/third-party-programs.txt
    build:
      skip: true  # [osx]
      script:
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja      # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=   # [win].
        - cmake {{ cmake_tcm_args }} -DTCM_TEST=OFF -S thread_composability_manager -B build_tcm
        - cmake --build build_tcm --parallel
        - cmake --install build_tcm --component devel
      ignore_run_exports:
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - winpthreads          # [win]
        - libwinpthread        # [win]
        - libxml2              # [not win]
        - libxml2-16           # [not win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ninja                # [win]
        - make                 # [not win]
        - cmake
      host:
        - libhwloc
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('tcm', exact=True) }}  # [not osx]
    test:
      requires:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ninja                # [win]
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - make                 # [not win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]
        - cmake
        - libhwloc
        # When cross-compiling we need to get uname from coreutils so that
        # CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR is set to the correct value
        - coreutils  # [build_platform != target_platform]
      source_files:
        - thread_composability_manager
      commands:
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=   # [win]
        - cmake {{ cmake_tcm_args }} -DTCM_TEST=ON -DTCM_DIR=ON -S thread_composability_manager -B tcm_test_build
        - cmake --build tcm_test_build --parallel  # build tests
        - cd tcm_test_build
        - ctest --output-on-failure

  - name: tbb
    about:
      summary: TBB Libraries
      license: Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - LICENSE.txt
        - third-party-programs.txt
    build:
      script:
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja      # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=   # [win]
        - cmake {{ cmake_args }} -DTBB_TEST=OFF -S . -B build
        - cmake --build build --parallel
        - cmake --install build --component runtime
      ignore_run_exports:
        # These libraries are only required for pkg_search_module to work correctly
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - winpthreads          # [win]
        - libwinpthread        # [win]
        - libxml2              # [not win]
        - libxml2-16           # [not win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - python *
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ninja                # [win]
        - make                 # [not win] 
        - cmake >=3.13
        - pkgconf
      host:
        - libhwloc
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]
      run:
        # oneTBB loads TCM dynamically at run time
        - {{ pin_subpackage('tcm', exact=True) }}  # [not osx]
    test:
      requires:
        # any python version is ok for sake of testing of shared libraries
        - python *
      commands:
        {% set libname = "libtbb.so.12" %}      # [linux]
        {% set libname = "libtbb.12.dylib" %}   # [osx]
        {% set libname = "tbb12.dll" %}         # [win]
        {% set win_extra = "os.add_dll_directory(os.environ['LIBRARY_BIN']); " if win else "" %}
        - python -c "import ctypes, os; {{ win_extra }} f = ctypes.cdll['{{ libname }}'].TBB_runtime_version; f.restype = ctypes.c_char_p; v = f().decode(); print(v); assert '{{ version }}' in v"

  - name: tbb-devel
    about:
      summary: TBB Development files
      license: Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - LICENSE.txt
        - third-party-programs.txt
    build:
      script:
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja      # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=   # [win]
        - cmake {{ cmake_args }} -DTBB_TEST=OFF -S . -B build
        - cmake --build build --parallel
        - cmake --install build --component devel
      run_exports:
        - tbb >={{ version }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        # These libraries are only required for pkg_search_module to work correctly
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - winpthreads          # [win]
        - libwinpthread        # [win]
        - libxml2              # [not win]
        - libxml2-16           # [not win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - python *
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ninja                # [win]
        - make                 # [not win] 
        - cmake >=3.13
        - pkgconf
      host:
        - libhwloc
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('tbb', exact=True) }}        # development package is for specific version of tbb
    test:
      requires:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ninja                # [win]
        - winpthreads-devel    # [win]
        - make                 # [not win]
        - libxml2-devel        # [not win]
        - cmake
        - pkgconf
        - libhwloc
        # When cross-compiling we need to get uname from coreutils so that
        # CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR is set to the correct value
        - coreutils  # [build_platform != target_platform]
      source_files:
        - cmake
        - test
        - CMakeLists.txt
        - include  # some tests depend on files from include
        - integration  # same
        - src      # some tests depend on files from src
      commands:
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=   # [win]
        # Setting TBB_DIR=ON and TBB_FIND_PACKAGE=ON is needed to use libraries from the tested package,
        # but do not build them from sources; real path to TBBConfig files is not required,
        # because CMake will successfully find installed tested package.
        - cmake {{ cmake_args }} -DTBB_TEST=ON -DTBB_DIR=ON -DTBB_FIND_PACKAGE=ON -S . -B test_build
        - cmake --build test_build --target {{ tests }} --parallel  # build tests
        - cd test_build
        - ctest -R "{{ ctest_regex }}" --output-on-failure

  - name: tbb4py
    about:
      summary: TBB module for Python
      license: Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - LICENSE.txt
        - third-party-programs.txt
    build:
      script:
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR=Ninja  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM=  # [win]
        - set CMAKE_GENERATOR_TOOLSET=   # [win]
        - cmake {{ cmake_tbb4py_args }} -DPython3_EXECUTABLE=$PYTHON -DPython3_ROOT_DIR=$PREFIX -DTBB4PY_BUILD=ON -DTBB_TEST=OFF -S . -B {{ tbb4py_build_dir }}  # [not win]
        - cmake {{ cmake_tbb4py_args }} -DPython3_EXECUTABLE=%PYTHON% -DPython3_ROOT_DIR=%PREFIX% -DTBB4PY_BUILD=ON -DTBB_TEST=OFF -S . -B {{ tbb4py_build_dir }}  # [win]
        - cmake --build {{ tbb4py_build_dir }} --target python_build --parallel
        - cmake --install {{ tbb4py_build_dir }} --component tbb4py
    requirements:
      build:
        - python                                 # [build_platform != target_platform]
        - cross-python_{{ target_platform }}     # [build_platform != target_platform]
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ninja  # [win]
        - make   # [not win]
        - cmake
        - swig
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - {{ pin_subpackage('tbb-devel', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - tbb >={{ version }}                            # while python module works with any compatible tbb...
        - python
    test:
      requires:
        - python
        - {{ pin_subpackage('tbb', exact=True) }}        # we want to test with this specific tbb package
      imports:
        - tbb
        - TBB
      commands:
        - python -m TBB -h
        - python -m tbb -h
        - python -m tbb test

about:
  home: https://github.com/uxlfoundation/oneTBB
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - third-party-programs.txt
  summary: High level abstract threading library
  dev_url: https://github.com/uxlfoundation/oneTBB
  doc_url: https://uxlfoundation.github.io/oneTBB/
